summary: zenntechinc-cli ships EtherHiding RCE loader in scaffolded ESLint config
details: The scaffolding template at templates/backend/.eslintrc.js appends heavily obfuscated code after the ESLint configuration export. When a developer scaffolds a project with this CLI and ESLint runs (lint scripts, editor-integrated lint, husky prepare hook, CI lint), the payload queries Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints (drpc.org, publicnode.com, blockscout, blast-api) for transactions from the hardcoded sender address 0xa322e5f36f0121063ed311d3080e9adc2490ef1a, decodes two IPv4 addresses from the `to` field of those transactions, fetches an XOR-encrypted blob over HTTP from those IPs, and passes the decrypted content to `eval(...)` and `spawn('node', ['-e',...])`. The loader uses obfuscator.io string-array-with-rotator obfuscation (`_0x355e` decoder, `_0x12f0` array, arithmetic index expressions) to hide the RPC hostnames, sender address, HTTP headers, and eval/spawn sinks. This is an on-chain-C2 (EtherHiding) remote-code-execution dropper: the attacker updates the C2 IP list by publishing new Ethereum transactions from the sender wallet, giving persistent attacker-controlled code execution on the developer's machine every time ESLint runs against the scaffolded project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
